description: Module 9+10 — Destination S3 upload, checksum verification, TransferJobService full lifecycle, admin APIs, retry API, unit tests
steps: Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/storage/destination/S3DestinationService.java interface — uploadDocument(byte[] bytes, String destinationBucket, String destinationKey, String mimeType, Insurer insurer) → DestinationUploadResult. DestinationUploadResult: { eTag, destinationKey, fileSizeBytes }. Also: verifyChecksum(String bucket, String key, String expectedChecksum, Insurer insurer) → boolean

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/storage/destination/AwsS3DestinationServiceImpl.java — @ConditionalOnProperty(name='aws.use-localstack', havingValue='false', matchIfMissing=true). Uses S3Client @Bean from AwsConfig. uploadDocument: (1) if insurer.destinationIamRoleArn is not null, use STS AssumeRole to get temporary credentials for cross-account access; create a new S3Client with those credentials; (2) build PutObjectRequest with bucket + key + contentType + contentLength; (3) upload bytes; (4) return result. verifyChecksum: download the object, compute SHA-256, compare to expected

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/storage/destination/LocalS3DestinationServiceImpl.java — @ConditionalOnProperty(name='aws.use-localstack', havingValue='true'). Same as Aws impl but uses LocalStack S3 endpoint from AwsConfig

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/transfer/service/TransferJobService.java interface + TransferJobServiceImpl.java — processTransferJob(UUID ingestionRequestId): (1) load IngestionRequest + TransferJob + all IngestionDocuments; (2) set TransferJob status to PROCESSING; (3) for each IngestionDocument: a) retrieve bytes (call DocumentRetrievalService which calls S3SourceService); b) validate document (call DocumentValidationService); c) if invalid → set document status DOCUMENT_REJECTED, mark job TRANSFER_FAILED; d) build destination S3 key: {insurer.destinationPathPrefix}/{productType}/{date}/{ingestionRequestId}/{documentType}_{documentId}.{ext}; e) upload to destination S3; f) verify checksum — if mismatch → set status CHECKSUM_MISMATCH and fail; g) save DestinationDocument record; (4) after all docs transferred → update TransferJob status TRANSFERRED, IngestionRequest status TRANSFERRED; (5) on failure increment retryCount — if retryCount >= maxRetries set DEAD_LETTER
Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/ingestion/dto/AdminIngestionResponse.java — all fields of IngestionRequest + TransferJob details + document details + validation result

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/ingestion/controller/AdminIngestionController.java — @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/v1/admin/requests'). GET /{ingestionRequestId} (full admin view), GET / (paginated list with @RequestParam filters: status, partnerId, insurerId, fromDate, toDate), POST /{ingestionRequestId}/retry (resets TRANSFER_FAILED jobs: set retryCount=0, status=QUEUED, create new OutboxEvent)
Update GET /api/v1/partner/status/{id} in IngestionController to return enriched IngestionStatusResponse including transfer details if TransferJob exists
Run mvn compile and mvn test — fix all errors
acceptance_criteria: Destination bucket ALWAYS comes from Insurer entity — never from partner request
Checksum mismatch causes job failure, not silent continuation
Admin retry endpoint resets retryCount and creates new OutboxEvent
Admin list endpoint supports pagination and filtering
